rootCause: The active Nginx virtual host forwarded its web locations to 127.0.0.1:3102, where no process was listening. The healthy recovery web container was bound to 127.0.0.1:3106. Its build also proxied same-origin API requests to an unavailable container-local port.
changes: Changed the affected web upstreams from 127.0.0.1:3102 to 127.0.0.1:3106.
Kept /api/revalidate on the Next.js web upstream.
Changed other /api/* traffic to the healthy local API upstream at 127.0.0.1:4101 with the /api prefix removed.
Built commit 72cd667 as an isolated image, validated it on 127.0.0.1:3107, then switched the five main-site web/static upstream entries and the dedicated tenant preview origin to 3107.
Replaced the five direct web proxy targets with an Nginx upstream that keeps 3107 primary and the verified 3106 rollback container as a hot standby.
Enabled two-attempt failover for connection errors, timeouts, and upstream 502/503/504 responses while keeping the API on 4101.
